artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\gamma$ denote the Euler–Mascheroni constant and, for a positive integer $m$, let $H_m = \sum_{j=1}^m 1/j$ denote the $m$-th harmonic number. For an integer $k \geq 3$, evaluate in closed form the multiple alternating Hardy series
$$
A_k \;=\; \sum_{n_1, n_2, \ldots, n_k \geq 1} (-1)^{n_1 + n_2 + \cdots + n_k}\Big( H_{n_1+n_2+\cdots+n_k} \;-\; \ln(n_1 + n_2 + \cdots + n_k) \;-\; \gamma \Big),
$$
expressing $A_k$ in terms of standard mathematical constants and elementary/special functions.
